snippet.title: 01 Our Hero Is Toppled | FINAL FANTASY ADVENTURE DX
snippet.description:
Hi everyone, and welcome to a new #letsplay ! And today, I am kicking off Final Fantasy Adventure, but not as you know it...
So, our intrepid hero MARK is forced to fight daily for the entertainment of the dastardly DARK LORD, until he gets a clue about how to escape from the dying whispers of a fellow combatant...
something something Mana Tree... something something Waterfall... something something pendant... some dude who may or may not be Gemma...
Anyway, I love this game. So join me as I, um, I mean MARK, embarks on an epic journey to rid himself of Dark Lord, and find out what all this Mana Tree business is about...
